title: Antiplagiarism check page (ingest contract v1)
description: One page of GET {base_url}/api/analytics/v1/checks. Normative wire format for the in-house noplagiat.tou.edu.kz pull endpoint; see docs/adr/010-source-ingest-contract.md. This file doubles as the fixture format for API-mode ingest tests.

records.description: Checks ordered by (checked_at ASC, check_id ASC), strictly after the requested cursor.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to pass to the next request, or null when the caller has caught up. Null is the only end-of-stream signal.

record.description: One check attempt. The property set is closed and contains no name, e-mail, title, author, document text or report link: anonymization is the source system's obligation, by contract (AGENTS.md invariant #1).

attempt_no.description: 1-based ordinal of this attempt for the same work. Assigned by the source, which knows which submissions are the same work.

work_type_code.description: Dictionary code; `other` when the source cannot classify the work.

faculty_code.description: Dictionary code; `UNASSIGNED` when the source cannot attribute the check to a unit.

department_code.description: Dictionary code; `UNASSIGNED` when the source cannot attribute the check to a unit.

program_code.description: Educational-programme code, or null. Nullable because the ОП drill-down is conditional on registrar data (PLAN §2, D2).

status.description: The source system's own verdict. Authoritative in API mode; `settings.status_rules` governs the CSV backfill (ADR-008 §4).

escalated.description: Referred to the Ethics Council. Independent of `status` - a recheck can be escalated (ADR-008 §4).

suspicion_cleared.description: «Отметка о подозрительности снята». Retained for auditability of `escalated`.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the check, or null. The only source for the average check time of TZ §4.2 §8.

deleted.description: «Удален» in the source. Excluded from analytics facts when settings.exclude_deleted is true, and always counted in ingest_batches.rows_skipped_deleted.

check_id.description: Opaque, stable identifier issued by the source system. The only identifier the warehouse stores.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit UTC offset.

dictionary_code.description: Stable dictionary code, resolved through `dict_aliases` on ingest. Never a human-readable label.

percentage.description: Percentage with at most two decimals, 0.00 through 100.00.
